issues.explanation: The chapter ends by sending Cao Cao back to Guandu after Chapter 30 already concluded the Guandu campaign with Yuan Shao's defeat and retreat. Without a clear time jump or indication of a later campaign, this reads as a repetition or timeline contradiction.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark the Guandu advance as a later campaign, or remove/rephrase it so the chapter ends with Yuan Shang succeeding the ill Yuan Shao and summoning the other commanders.
